-   **Rarity note:** Migratory bird found throughout Florida in shallow-water habitats.

## Natural history notes

A large white wading bird characterized by its long neck, dagger-like yellow bill, black legs, and very long black feet. In Florida, it is found in marshes, swamps, ponds, lakes, mangroves, coastal lagoons, tidal flats, roadside ditches, and other shallow-water habitats. It feeds mainly on fish, frogs, crayfish, insects, and other small aquatic animals, usually hunting by standing still or slowly stalking through shallow water before striking quickly with its bill.
